svg.desc: Every finite logged loss through the selected elapsed cutoff. Filled black circles are feasible, grey hollow circles are infeasible or unknown. Black step line is best logged feasible loss. The lower rug marks feasible calls. Full data are provided in CSV and original JSON.

g.text: Actual logged elapsed seconds · filled circles: feasible · line: best feasible
